subject: Momentum preservation request — short POC credit & schedule shift
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@picohealth.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: short extension + credits while we unblock integration

Hi Connor,

Quick note from our side — we hit a blocking issue in our adapter to your embeddings endpoint. Our backend team is swamped with an unrelated compliance audit and we need a little runway to finish the connector fix. The POC timeline is slipping and we risk losing momentum with our stakeholders.

Can Redwood add a short extension to the POC (14 days) and a small sandbox credit top-up so we can complete the integration without switching vendors? If helpful I've attached the error logs and a screenshot of the failing request flow.

We'd like to keep the demo scheduled for Dec 16 if possible. Appreciate anything you can do here.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of ML Integrations
PicoHealth
Attachments: error-log.txt (text), integration-screenshot.png (image)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@picohealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-30T10:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits while we unblock integration

Hi Elena — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear you ran into that during the onboarding.

Quick plan: I will loop in Marissa (Solutions Engineering) to triage the failure immediately. From a commercial side I can provision an interim sandbox credit of $1,500 right away pending approval from my manager; if Marissa confirms the blocker matches what you sent we can also approve a 14-day POC stretch.

Can you confirm the exact API call timestamp (UTC) and the environment name (staging / sandbox / prod) that produced the log? That will speed troubleshooting. I flagged this as high priority.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@picohealth.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-12-01T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits while we unblock integration

Hi Elena — Marissa from Solutions Eng here. I pulled the logs and it looks like a missing header in the staging adapter combined with an unexpected redirect from Pico's auth service. I replicated the failure locally and have a patch suggestion that should clear it.

Commercially — Connor and I discussed this with Ben. We can issue an immediate $1,500 sandbox credit to your PicoHealth account to cover the next round of tests, and we will extend the POC window by 14 calendar days (decoupled from your current expiration). I attached a short approval PDF you can reference for procurement.

Action items for your team:
- Confirm the failing API timestamp (UTC) so I can match traces
- Run the patched adapter I attached (single-file diff) on your staging environment
- Share any new error snapshots if problems persist

I'll be available tomorrow 9–11 PT for a quick screen-share if you'd like me to walk the patch through.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachments: poc-extension-approval.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Request: short extension + credits while we unblock integration

+1 on the $1.5k credit and 14-day extension. Please log the credit against DEAL-2026-7381 and add a note to the HubSpot record with the new expiration date: 2027-01-01.

Connor — once the credit is applied, please confirm to Elena and close the loop. If procurement needs a PO/approval email, route it through Laura and she will attach the standard SOW addendum.

Thanks team — nice triage on the quick win.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@picohealth.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-12-02T15:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: short extension + credits while we unblock integration

Connor / Marissa — amazing, thank you. We verified the UTC timestamp: 2026-11-28T22:41:50Z and confirmed the environment was staging. I'll try the patch now and will confirm as soon as we see green. The new demo window on Dec 16 works for our stakeholders if the integration is cleared by then.

Appreciate the quick support — this makes a big difference for our internal buy-in.

Best,
Elena
Head of ML Integrations, PicoHealth
